verdict.rationale: Codex can run with an OpenAI API key instead of a ChatGPT sign-in (codex-gh-4). The OpenAI platform's RBAC lets you create custom roles with exact permissions, scoped at the organization or project level (codex-docs-28). Together these suggest a least-privilege setup for an agent's credentials is possible, but the evidence never describes issuing scoped API keys for Codex agents directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating permission-scoped or restricted API keys for Codex, a per-agent credential issuance or rotation workflow, a link between RBAC scoping and Codex agent use, independent corroboration.
